decisions.subject: FY-5: a neighbouring house at exactly 15.0 m qualifies; "15.0 metres or less" is inclusive (a new ruling)
decisions.recommendation: FY-5 sign-off answer (signoff/answers.md): "both keep", in reply to "15.0 counts, keep". Rule text: A neighbouring house at exactly 15.0 m from the lot counts: "15.0 metres or less" in 10.5.40.70(1) is inclusive, so the averaging rule 10.5.40.70(1)(B) and the single-neighbour rule 10.5.40.70(1)(A) apply to a building at 15.0 m, and a building beyond 15.0 m does not count. M-423 stores the number 15.0 m (as averaging_distance_m); this row decides the boundary it is compared with. MB-64 FY-5 (a neighbour at exactly 15.0 m; the answer 5 m) follows this row.
